title: Cute color and shape. Interior needs new design though.
text: Cute color and shape. Interior needs new design though.. Even set on the super quiet mode, I can hear this at night and it keeps me up. I don’t think it keeps my skin care items as cold as I’d like either when it’s on super quiet mode. I love that the door has a place for face or eye masks. The little shelf is helpful. I wish there was a sliding shelf option though maybe half way up the interior to maximize space. Even with the little shelf, you can see how little space there is inside. Such a first world problem. But still, this isn’t the right fridge for me.

product_metadata.title: QUBI Mini Fridge, Professional Skincare Fridge, Mini Cosmetics Makeup Fridge, Compact Fridge 5 Liter (Cream White, 5L)
features: PROFESSIONAL BEAUTY FRIDGE: The Qubi mini fridge is designed for your skincare and cosmetics. There is room for each of your skin care product. Any temperature-sensitive skincare products can be stored in this beauty fridge.

INTELLIGENT CLIMATE CONTROL SYSTEM: Unlike other skincare fridges, Qubi mini fridge uses an auto climate control system to eliminate water left inside the fridge problem. The temperature and humidity inside the fridge are always at the perfect level for your skincare products.

THE PERFECT TEMPERATURE FOR SKINCARE: 50°F/65°F is the right temperature for most of your skincare products. Store them at the right condition can extend their shelf life and That is why we only have two temperature switches for the makeup fridge. 65°F is for Fall and Winter. 50°F is for Spring and Summer.

ULTRA SILENT OPERATION MODE: We understand many of the skincare fridges are placed in the bedroom, so noise control is crucial. Our mini fridge for skincare operates at a very low noise mode. You can hardly hear any noise even while you sleep at night.

STATE OF ART LOOKING: This beautifully designed Qubi cosmetic fridge will be a perfect fit for your makeup desk. We used the best material and coating finish to make sure your expensive skincare products feel like live in a villa. There are two colors choices, a pink mini fridge, or white mini fridge.
